# KD Flowers

KD Flowers is a wedding floral design studio in the Niagara Region of Ontario,
Canada, owned by Kylee Danielle. The studio designs personalized wedding
flowers and bridal bouquets for couples across Niagara and St. Catharines, with
a focus on elegant, lavish flowers at an affordable price.

Website: https://www.kdflowers.ca/
Owner: Kylee Danielle
Business type: Wedding florist / wedding floral design
Service region: Niagara Region, Ontario, Canada
Primary booking channel: https://calendly.com/kdflowers/free-consult
Instagram: https://instagram.com/kdflowersniagara

## Primary services

- Wedding floral design
- Bridal bouquets
- Boutonnières and wedding-party flowers
- Personalized wedding flower consultations
- Wedding flower estimates covering flowers, labour and delivery

KD Flowers works with each couple to reflect their style and love for one
another through custom wedding flowers. Design consultations can take place in
person, or by e-mail, phone call or text when an in-person meeting is not
possible.

## Wedding floral design specialties

- Personalized, elegant and lavish wedding flowers
- Affordable wedding flowers and inexpensive bridal bouquets
- Custom colour, flower and style planning
- Bridal party flowers and ceremony/reception florals
- Local sourcing, including flowers purchased from a couple's preferred supplier
  or from a local florist

## Geographic service areas

KD Flowers serves Niagara and St. Catharines, Ontario, including:

- Beamsville
- Fonthill
- Fort Erie
- Grimsby
- Jordan, Ontario
- Pelham
- Port Colborne
- Port Dalhousie
- Smithville
- Thorold
- Vineland
- Virgil
- Wainfleet
- Welland

## Brand positioning

KD Flowers is a personal, home-based wedding floral design business rather than
a large retail flower shop. Kylee Danielle has been helping brides create their
wedding flower vision for over ten years. The brand emphasizes a hands-on
consultation process, custom design, personal service and affordable pricing.
No public storefront address, telephone number or email address is published on
the website.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I book a wedding flower consultation?

Book a free consultation through the KD Flowers Calendly page at
https://calendly.com/kdflowers/free-consult.

### What is included in a wedding flower estimate?

Once the flowers, design and style are confirmed, KD Flowers prepares an
estimate that includes the cost of flowers, labour and delivery.

### Does KD Flowers serve my city?

KD Flowers serves Niagara and St. Catharines, including Beamsville, Fonthill,
Fort Erie, Grimsby, Jordan, Pelham, Port Colborne, Port Dalhousie, Smithville,
Thorold, Vineland, Virgil, Wainfleet and Welland.

### Can I choose where the wedding flowers are purchased?

Yes. Brides are welcome to have their flowers purchased from wherever they
prefer. If there is no preference, KD Flowers orders from a local florist.

### Does KD Flowers have a public storefront?

KD Flowers works out of the owner's home. No public storefront address or
walk-in hours are published on the website; consultations are booked in advance.

### How much experience does KD Flowers have?

Kylee Danielle has been helping brides create their wedding flower vision for
over ten years.
